subject: Partner Equipment
text: Partners automatically switch equipment at levels 102, 108, and 114, with Klein's levels differing.

evidence.quote: レベル102、108、114で自動的に持ち替えが発生（クラインのみレベルが違う）
evidence.translation: Automatic equipment switches occur at levels 102, 108, and 114 (only Klein's levels differ).

subject: Asuna
text: Only Asuna's equipment can be examined in detail, and it cannot be viewed while her marriage is dissolved.

evidence.quote: 仕様上、装備を詳細に確認出来るのはアスナのみ。彼女も結婚解除中は見れなくなる。
evidence.translation: By design, only Asuna's equipment can be checked in detail, and it also cannot be viewed while her marriage is dissolved.

subject: Equipment Gifting
text: As friendship rises, equipment gifts become possible: weapons at RANK2, and armor plus body and neck items at RANK1.

evidence.quote: 友好度が向上すると装備品のプレゼントが可能になる（RANK2で武器、RANK1で防具、体・首）。
evidence.translation: When friendship increases, giving equipment as gifts becomes possible (weapons at RANK2, armor and body/neck items at RANK1).

subject: Equipment Gifting
text: A partner refuses a gift whose sell price is lower than their current equipment, saying they like what they have.

evidence.quote: 装備しているよりも売値の低いものを贈ろうとすると、現状のものが気に入っているからと拒まれる。
evidence.translation: If you try to give an item with a lower sell price than the equipment they are wearing, the partner refuses, saying they like their current equipment.

subject: Partner Training
text: Partner actions are classified into 12 items on the ◇ graph (3 categories of 4 types each), and each GOOD! command raises the matching item.

evidence.quote: パートナーの行動は一部を除き『パートナー情報』における◇グラフの各頂点（3系統4種）12項目の分類がされており、GOOD!指示に応じてグラフの該当項目が伸びていく。
evidence.translation: Partner actions, except for some, are classified into 12 items at the vertices of the ◇ graph in Partner Info (3 categories, 4 types each), and the matching item grows when a GOOD! command is given.

subject: Partner Training
text: Usage rates are also set per skill, so continuously giving GOOD! to a specific skill makes the partner use it as its main skill.

evidence.quote: 行動のほかにスキル単位でも使用率が設定されており、特定のスキルをGOOD!し続ければそれをメインに使うようにもなる。
evidence.translation: Besides actions, usage rates are also set per skill, and if you keep giving GOOD! to a specific skill, the partner also comes to use it as its main skill.

subject: Battle Type
text: When a specific item grows beyond a set level, the Battle Type in character info changes, but this is only a title with no special effect.

evidence.quote: 特定の項目が一定以上に伸びる事で、キャラクター情報のBattle Typeが変化する。が、これは項目が伸びた証・称号であり、特別な効果は無い。
evidence.translation: When a specific item grows beyond a certain level, the Battle Type in character info changes; however, this is only proof of growth and a title, with no special effect.

subject: Partner Training
text: Giving GOOD! to items shrinks growth in other categories, so not all items can be raised.

evidence.quote: GOOD!した項目に連動して別系統の項目の伸びが縮小してしまうため、全項目を伸ばす事は出来ない。
evidence.translation: Because growth in other categories shrinks in conjunction with items given GOOD!, not all items can be raised.

subject: Secret Sword Skill
text: Secret sword skills become usable once attack sword skill growth, or overall DEF and BUF growth, reaches a certain level.

evidence.quote: 奥義ソードスキルは攻撃ソードスキルorDEF・BUF系全体の伸びが一定以上になることで使用可能になる。
evidence.translation: Secret sword skills become usable when growth in attack sword skills, or in the DEF and BUF categories as a whole, reaches a certain level.

subject: Secret Sword Skill
text: Raising attack sword skills makes the secret skill count as an attack sword skill, but DEF and BUF growth has no category, so GOOD! cannot restore SP for it.

evidence.quote: 攻撃ソードスキルを伸ばした場合は使用時に攻撃ソードスキル扱いになるが、他2系統の場合はカテゴリがつかない。よって後者ではGOOD!でのSP回復が不可能。
evidence.translation: If attack sword skill growth is raised, the skill is treated as an attack sword skill when used, but in the other two categories no category is attached, so GOOD! cannot restore SP in the latter case.

subject: Battle Skill
text: Probably as friendship rises through RANK1 and MAX, partners start using battle skills they previously did not use.

evidence.quote: また、おそらく友好度の上昇（RANK1、MAXの2段階）でそれまでは使わなかったバトルスキルを使用するようにもなる。
evidence.translation: Also, probably as friendship rises (in two stages, RANK1 and MAX), partners come to use battle skills they did not use before.

subject: Silica
text: The guide's sword skill table lists Silica's skills as Fad Edge, Infinite, Shadow Stitch, Cross Edge, Rapid Bite, Armor Pierce and Tri-Pierce.

evidence.quote: シリカ | ファッド・エッジ...>インフィニット...>>シャドウ・ステッチ | クロス・エッジ...ラピッド・バイト | アーマー・ピアース...トライ・ピアース
evidence.translation: Silica: Fad Edge, Infinite, Shadow Stitch, Cross Edge, Rapid Bite, Armor Pierce, Tri-Pierce.

subject: Leafa
text: The guide's sword skill table lists Leafa's skills as Horizontal Square, Vertical Square, Star Q Prominence, Sonic Leap, Sharp Nail, Horizontal and Slant.

evidence.quote: リーファ | ホリゾンタル・スクエア...>バーチカル・スクエア...>>スター・Q・プロミネンス | ソニック・リープ...シャープ・ネイル | ホリゾンタル...スラント
evidence.translation: Leafa: Horizontal Square, Vertical Square, Star Q Prominence, Sonic Leap, Sharp Nail, Horizontal, Slant.

subject: Asuna
text: The guide's sword skill table lists Asuna's skills as Accel Stab, Penetrate, Delta Attack, Overradiation, Linear, Streak, Rip Ravine and Sweep.

evidence.quote: アスナ | アクセル・スタブ...>ペネトレイト...>>デルタ・アタック...>>>オーバーラジェーション | リニアー...ストリーク | リップ・ラヴィーネ...スウィープ
evidence.translation: Asuna: Accel Stab, Penetrate, Delta Attack, Overradiation, Linear, Streak, Rip Ravine, Sweep.

subject: Lisbeth
text: The guide's sword skill table lists Lisbeth's skills as Trice Blow, Brutal Strike, Trinity Arts, Silent Blow, Power Strike, Strike Heart and Diastrophism.

evidence.quote: リズベット | トライス・ブロウ...>ブルータル・ストライク...>>トリニティ・アーツ | サイレント・ブロウ...パワー・ストライク | ストライク・ハート...ダイアストロフィズム
evidence.translation: Lisbeth: Trice Blow, Brutal Strike, Trinity Arts, Silent Blow, Power Strike, Strike Heart, Diastrophism.

subject: Sinon
text: The guide's sword skill table lists Sinon's skills as Hail Bullet, Target Weak, Time of Snap and Aim Shoot.

evidence.quote: シノン | ヘイル・バレット | ターゲット・ウィーク | タイム・オブ・スナップ...エイム・シュート
evidence.translation: Sinon: Hail Bullet, Target Weak, Time of Snap, Aim Shoot.

subject: Klein
text: The guide's sword skill table lists Klein's skills as Scarlet Fan, Eagle Feather, Rasetsu, Sensha, Ukifune, Gengetsu and Tsujikaze.

evidence.quote: クライン | 緋扇...鷲羽...>>羅刹 | 旋車...浮舟 | 幻月...辻風
evidence.translation: Klein: Scarlet Fan, Eagle Feather, Rasetsu, Sensha, Ukifune, Gengetsu, Tsujikaze.

subject: Attack Support Skill
text: The battle skill table lists attack support skills War Cry, Sharp Rage, First Step, Brave Stream and Perfection Style.

evidence.quote: 攻撃支援スキル | ウォークライ...シャープレイジ...ファーストステップ | ブレイブストリーム | パーフェクションスタイル
evidence.translation: Attack support skills: War Cry, Sharp Rage, First Step, Brave Stream, Perfection Style.

subject: Defense Support Skill
text: The battle skill table lists defense support skills Parrying, Shield Coating, Phantom of Protection, Protection Seal, Robe of Mercy and Defense Stance (instruction-only).

evidence.quote: 防御支援スキル | パリング...シールドコーティング...護法の幻影 | プロテクションシール | 慈悲の衣 | ディフェンススタンス...（指示限定）
evidence.translation: Defense support skills: Parrying, Shield Coating, Phantom of Protection, Protection Seal, Robe of Mercy, Defense Stance (instruction-only).

subject: Disturbance Support Skill
text: The battle skill table lists disturbance support skills Slow Weakness, Hiding Slide, Phantom Break, Miserable Heart and Insanity Knight.

evidence.quote: 妨害支援スキル | スロウウィークネス...ハイディングスライド...ファントムブレイク | ミゼラブルハート | インサニティナイト
evidence.translation: Disturbance support skills: Slow Weakness, Hiding Slide, Phantom Break, Miserable Heart, Insanity Knight.

subject: Partner AI
text: The partner AI's basic 'use skill at 300 SP' behavior works well with battle skill SP costs and SP recovery from GOOD! commands.

evidence.quote: 『SP300でスキル使用』のパートナーAIの基本思考に、バトルスキルの消費SPとGOOD!指示によるSP回復が噛み合って扱いやすい。
evidence.translation: The partner AI's basic thinking of 'use skill at SP300' meshes well with battle skill SP consumption and SP recovery from GOOD! commands, making it easy to handle.

subject: Chain Burst
text: Chain actions change which sword skills the partner uses, while other skill use and movement stay the same.

evidence.quote: 連携行動時に使うソードスキルが変化。それ以外でのスキル使用や立ち回り方には特別な変化は無い。
evidence.translation: The sword skills used during chain actions change; otherwise, skill use and movement have no special change.

subject: Quick Linker
text: Like Chain, switch actions change the skills the partner uses.

evidence.quote: Chain同様、スイッチ時に使うスキルが変化。
evidence.translation: Like Chain, the skills used during a switch change.

subject: Sword Skill
text: Attack sword skill growth does not affect spontaneous use at 300 SP, and only affects sword skills used by Kirito's command.

evidence.quote: 攻撃ソードスキルの伸びはSP300での自発スキル使用での使用率には影響せず、キリトからの指示でソードスキルを使う場合のみ影響する。
evidence.translation: Growth in attack sword skills does not affect the usage rate of spontaneous skill use at SP300; it only affects sword skills used by Kirito's command.

subject: Sword Skill
text: To have partners use sword skills actively on their own, the disturbance and debuff sword skills must be raised.

evidence.quote: 自発使用で積極的にソードスキルを使って欲しい場合は、妨害・弱体ソードスキルを伸ばす必要がある。
evidence.translation: If you want sword skills used actively in spontaneous use, the disturbance and debuff sword skills need to be raised.
